projectDescription: Tamper-proof audit logging platform with cryptographic hash chaining, WORM storage, and built-in compliance support for DORA, GDPR, NIS2, the EU AI Act, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and the Italian Garante provision on system administrators.
keyFeatures: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining — any tampered event breaks the chain instantly
WORM storage via S3 Object Lock in COMPLIANCE mode — immutable even against AWS root
8 compliance frameworks: DORA, GDPR, NIS2, EU AI Act, ISO 27001, SOC 2, Provv. Amministratori di Sistema, PCI DSS
Drop-in SDKs for Node.js, Python, Go, Java, and PHP with fire-and-forget logging
Real-time ClickHouse-powered search across billions of events
DSAR export and deletion workflows for GDPR Article 15/17 compliance
Role-based access control with Admin, Member, and Auditor roles
CSV export for audit evidence packages
Compliance dashboard with auto-verification of logging requirements
Idempotent event ingestion with Idempotency-Key header support
publicApiSurface: POST /v1/events — log a single audit event
POST /v1/events/batch — log up to 100 events in one request
GET /v1/events — list events with filters and cursor-based pagination
GET /v1/events/{log_id} — retrieve a single event with hash chain details
GET /v1/events/verify — verify hash chain integrity over a range of sequence numbers
GET /v1/actions — retrieve the compliance action catalog
DSAR Export — dashboard-initiated export of all events for a specific actor
DSAR Delete — dashboard-initiated deletion of all events for a specific actor
SDK: audit.log(event) — buffered fire-and-forget event logging
SDK: audit.logDirect(event) — synchronous event logging with response
SDK: audit.logBatchDirect(events) — synchronous batch event logging
SDK: audit.flush() — flush buffered events immediately
SDK: audit.close() — graceful shutdown with final flush
